description: This file contains Python code for resolving interface dependencies in a code generation or IDL processing system. It defines classes and functions to read, merge, and manage interface dependency data, including handling partial interfaces, extended attributes, and inheritance of unforgeable attributes.

classes.name: InterfaceDependencyResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving interface dependencies by merging partial interfaces and implemented interfaces into main IDL definitions.

methods.name: resolve_dependencies
methods.description: Resolves dependencies for a given IDL definitions object, merging partial interfaces and referenced interfaces, and updating extended attributes.

methods.name: merge_interface_dependencies
methods.description: Merges dependencies such as partial interfaces and implemented interfaces into a target interface based on dependency files.

methods.name: transfer_extended_attributes
methods.description: Transfers specific extended attributes from dependency interfaces onto their members, modifying the interface in place.

methods.name: inherit_unforgeable_attributes
methods.description: Inherits [Unforgeable] attributes from ancestor interfaces and updates the interface attributes accordingly.
